I replied in #coastal-team to Bettina. I did not set up the recurring Monday 08:00 digest. This session has no scheduler that posts into Slack; the only scheduler I have saves output locally. So nothing is scheduled.

Instead, I offered to post the digest by hand each Monday when she asks in #coastal-team. It would cover the previous week from #coastal-team and #coastal-random, plus open customer items, and would leave out finance figures.
